title: Recruited into Army intelligence by a civilian in the Fort Jackson beer hall
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Recruited into Army intelligence by a civilian in the Fort Jackson beer hall, about 1960s at Fort Jackson, South Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and so when I went in the trailer I found out that he was a guy who was in intelligence

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man who says he served in the US Army, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about how he got into Army intelligence, the part of the Army that gathers secret information. He says that in the 1960s, at Fort Jackson, an Army training base in South Carolina, he met a man in civilian clothes at the base beer hall. When he later went into the man's trailer, McMoneagle says, he found out the man worked in intelligence, and that this meeting was the start of his recruitment.
